findings: Current v3 42-fit plan and C1/C2 remain smaller development studies; the candidate correctly preserves the separate original twelve-config/three-tuning/five-fresh-seed recipe.

The common-LR mean-over-three rule, both-LR retention, strict-best checkpoint, immutable frozen frontend and unchanged 256-event reset/first-gap semantics agree with the actual v8 interface and resource analysis.

Prediction-only dummy labels must mark every real event valid and padding invalid; they must never recreate label-dependent selection. This is stated by the feature/label isolation proposal, and implementation remains future work.
The stricter all-selected-seeds adequacy gate and no weaker-LR fallback are prospective candidate rules; they do not retroactively qualify existing runs.
No blocking contradiction found in the text. The 240-second per-model budget is an unverified E runtime allowance; failures must remain failures, and the existing no-extension rule is appropriate.
No evidence about C2 terminal quality, numerical admission or E outcomes was inferred from this protocol review.
scope: Static protocol consistency only; no E data, checkpoints, training, forward/backward, optimizer or native job access. Not execution authorization.
